name: Account takeover
plainEnglish: A criminal gets into a real customer's account and uses it as if they were the customer.
warningSigns: A device the customer has never used before
Password, email or phone number changed shortly before a payment
A new payee followed quickly by a large withdrawal
Activity at an unusual time for this customer
howToRespond: Stop the payment and contact the customer on details held before the recent changes.

name: Genuine customer: travelling abroad
plainEnglish: A real customer spending in another country. A foreign location on its own is not fraud.
warningSigns: Spending that fits a trip: hotels, transport, food
No recent changes to login or contact details
Earlier travel bookings on the account
howToRespond: Approve. Declining leaves a real customer stranded without money abroad.

name: Crypto cash-out to a fresh wallet
plainEnglish: Stolen or fraudulent funds are converted to crypto and sent to a brand-new wallet, where they are very hard to recover.
warningSigns: A very new account with deposits but no normal activity
Several different cards funding one account
Withdrawal of nearly the whole balance soon after deposit
Destination wallet created very recently or linked to risky wallets
howToRespond: Hold the withdrawal and review where the deposits came from before any funds leave.
